title: Tiny Vscode extensions to monitor your agent usage
author: Evile_Gaming
selftext:
I made a few tiny VS Code extensions because running multiple AI coding sessions was getting surprisingly annoying. I often have several VS Code windows open with different agents/workspaces. Two things kept tripping me up, which session am I looking at, how much quota have I got left?

So I built a handful of tiny Vscode extensions to help with this:

Workspace Colors gives each workspace its own title bar/editor/pane colours, so overlapping VS Code windows are immediately recognisable.

Codex Quota shows the remaining 5-hour and weekly Codex quota in the status bar.

Claude Quota same idea for Claude Code.

GLM Quota quota display for the ZAI GLM Coding Plan.

They're deliberately small tools rather than another AI dashboard. The quota extensions try to use the credentials/tooling you already have rather than inventing another service around them.

Source is public, and the VSIX files can be downloaded directly.

[https://evile.uk/redesign/tools/](https://evile.uk/redesign/tools/)

comments.author: Evile_Gaming
comments.body: Lots of serious SWEs, If you want to be able to use official extensions for enterprise level environments, VScode has them. I have around 138 extensions for things like atomsphere, K8, MSSQL server. Some of my clients insist on AI-free-dev. So I still have to write actual code which needs a proper IDE.
